| Model | Role | Parameters |
|---|---|---:|
| B0 | fit-only target mean | 0 |
| B3 | direct SD+FLUX product-space predictor | 728,576 |
| M1 | predictive `U[16,128]` bottleneck | 730,624 |

共同训练配置：seed=`20260826`、AdamW、lr=`3e-4`、minimum lr=`3e-5`、betas=`0.9/0.95`、weight decay=`1e-4`、warmup=`500`、batch=`32`、每个执行模型 `12,000` updates、validation every `500`、gradient clip=`1.0`、BF16。

\[
D_U=(L_{M1}-L_{B3})/L_{B3},\qquad \operatorname{upper}(D_U)<0.05.
\]
